changes.t: AAG is now Astro-Core under NSF 26-522 (posted Aug 17, 2026). Proposals are accepted anytime, and the solicitation sets no target date; FY2027 is flagged as especially competitive.
ATP, ADAP, FINESST and the guest-investigator programs are waiting on it. LISA Preparatory Science was not solicited in ROSES-24 or ROSES-25.
WoU-MMA, MPS-Ascend and Mid-scale RI-2 are archived. MRI is waiting for a new solicitation.
Calls for observing time are listed under Telescope Time, and only calls Yale astronomers can apply to are included. Yale's own Keck and Palomar time goes through the Yale Time Allocation Committee.
The President's FY2027 request cuts NSF by 55% and NASA Astrophysics research and analysis from $113.7M to $46.6M. Appropriations are still pending.
